Name: `BOOT_USE_NTFS3`
Description: Enable NTFS3 on initrd. Unset to disable.
Notes: Set this for BlissOS on NTFS setup.

Name: `VOLD_USE_NTFS3`
Description: Enable NTFS3 for vold. Unset to disable.
Notes: Set this to use NTFS3 when using NTFS drives on Android. We really recommend this driver !

Name: `USE_NTFS3`
Description: Enable NTFS3 on both initrd and vold. Unset to disable.
